table.name: Country
table.purpose: Lookup table of countries covered by the database (11 European football countries such as England, Germany, Spain, France). Each row is one country, identified by an opaque numeric id that League and Match reference to indicate where a league or match takes place. Part of a European football (soccer) dataset alongside League, Match, Player, Player_Attributes, Team, and Team_Attributes (matches the well-known European Soccer Database schema).

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key of the country; an opaque numeric identifier (not a standard ISO code, since values like 1729 for England don't match ISO 3166-1 numeric). Referenced by Match.country_id, Match.league_id, and League.country_id, so it identifies the country a league/match belongs to.

name.name: name
name.description: Name of the country (e.g., England, Germany, Portugal). Unique across the 11 rows, one per country.

table.name: League
table.purpose: Lookup table of the 11 European football (soccer) leagues covered by the database, one row per league, each tied to a country in Country and referenced by Match. Likely part of a football match/player dataset (resembling the European Soccer Database).

country_id.name: country_id
country_id.description: Identifier of the country in which the league is based; foreign key to Country.id. In this dataset each league maps one-to-one to a country, and the value is identical to the league's own id.

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key of the league; unique identifier used by Match.league_id and Match.country_id. Values mirror the country_id of the league's country (e.g. 1729 = England Premier League).

name.name: name
name.description: Full name of the football league, combining country and league name (e.g. 'England Premier League', 'Germany 1. Bundesliga').

table.name: Match
table.purpose: One row per professional football (soccer) match: teams, final score, league/season/matchday, date, both teams' starting lineups with formation coordinates, per-bookmaker pre-match 1X2 betting odds, and XML event data (goals, cards, corners, crosses, fouls, shots, possession). Covers ~26k matches across 11 European leagues, 2008–2016.

match_api_id.name: match_api_id
match_api_id.description: External API identifier of the match (unique per row, ~483129–2216672); the natural key used by the source data provider.

possession.name: possession_events_xml
possession.description: XML blob listing the match's possession data, typically per-interval home/away possession percentages (homepos/awaypos); '<possession />' means no data.

season.description: Season label in 'YYYY/YYYY' format (2008/2009 through 2015/2016) indicating the competition season the match belongs to.

shotoff.name: shot_off_target_events_xml
shotoff.description: XML blob listing the match's shots off target with minute and event metadata; '<shotoff />' means none.

shoton.name: shot_on_target_events_xml
shoton.description: XML blob listing the match's shots on target with minute and event metadata; '<shoton />' means none.

stage.name: matchday
stage.description: Round/matchday number within the league season (1–38, matching a 38-round league format).

table.name: Player
table.purpose: One row per football (soccer) player: identity (name, birthday), physical attributes (height in cm, weight in lbs), and two external identifiers — one for the match-statistics API (player_api_id, used in Match lineups and Player_Attributes) and one for the FIFA/EA Sports API (player_fifa_api_id, used in Player_Attributes). The internal id is the surrogate primary key. Part of a European soccer database alongside Country, League, Match, Team, Player_Attributes, Team_Attributes. Note: the join from Player.id to Team_Attributes/Match team columns reported by statistics is spurious (id coincidentally matches team_api_id values); the meaningful joins are via player_api_id and player_fifa_api_id to Player_Attributes and the Match home/away_player_N columns.

birthday.name: birthday
birthday.description: Player's date of birth (stored as datetime with zero time part). Range 1967–1999 fits professional footballers.

height.name: height
height.description: Player's height in centimeters (values like 182.88, 187.96 are inch-to-cm conversions; range 157.48–208.28 cm).

id.name: id
id.description: Surrogate primary key of the Player table; unique row identifier with no external meaning.

player_api_id.name: player_api_id
player_api_id.description: External API identifier for the player (source dataset's API, e.g. the European Soccer Database's data provider). Referenced by Player_Attributes and by the per-position player columns in Match (home_player_1..11, away_player_1..11).

player_fifa_api_id.name: player_fifa_api_id
player_fifa_api_id.description: Player's identifier in the FIFA (EA Sports) API; joins to Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id.

player_name.name: player_name
player_name.description: Player's full (or common) name; not unique — 10848 distinct names for 11060 players (e.g. 'Danilo' appears 7 times for different players).

weight.name: weight
weight.description: Player's weight in pounds (integer, range 117–243, mean ~168, consistent with lbs rather than kg).

table.name: Player_Attributes
table.purpose: Time-series of FIFA/EA football (soccer) player ratings. Each row is one snapshot of a player's skill attributes (overall rating, potential, and ~35 individual skill ratings on a 1-99 scale, plus preferred foot and attacking/defensive work rates) as of a given rating date. A player has one row per rating update (roughly per FIFA release, 2007-2016). Players are linked to the Player table via player_api_id / player_fifa_api_id. This matches the well-known 'European Soccer Database' schema (Country, League, Match, Player, Team, Team_Attributes).

acceleration.name: acceleration
acceleration.description: FIFA-style player attribute rating (1-99 scale): acceleration, i.e. how quickly the player reaches top speed. One row per player per rating date.

aggression.name: aggression
aggression.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): aggression of the player in duels/tackles.

agility.name: agility
agility.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): agility, i.e. movement nimbleness.

attacking_work_rate.name: attacking_work_rate
attacking_work_rate.description: Player's attacking work rate as a category: low / medium / high. Contains dirty values ('None', 'norm', 'stoc', 'le') indicating data-quality issues in the source.

balance.name: balance
balance.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): balance of the player.

ball_control.name: ball_control
ball_control.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): ball control skill.

curve.name: curve
curve.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): ability to curve the ball (passing/shooting).

date.name: rating_date
date.description: Date on which this set of player ratings was recorded (FIFA/EA rating update date). 197 distinct dates between 2007-02-22 and 2016-07-07; each player has multiple rows, one per rating date.

defensive_work_rate.name: defensive_work_rate
defensive_work_rate.description: Player's defensive work rate as a category: low / medium / high. Heavily polluted with junk values ('_0', 'o', '2', '9', 'es', '7'), indicating data-quality problems in the source.

finishing.name: finishing
finishing.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): finishing skill (scoring in front of goal).

free_kick_accuracy.name: free_kick_accuracy
free_kick_accuracy.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): free kick accuracy.

gk_diving.name: gk_diving
gk_diving.description: FIFA-style goalkeeper attribute rating (1-99): diving. Very low values for most rows because most players are not goalkeepers.

gk_handling.name: gk_handling
gk_handling.description: FIFA-style goalkeeper attribute rating (1-99): handling of the ball.

gk_kicking.name: gk_kicking
gk_kicking.description: FIFA-style goalkeeper attribute rating (1-99): kicking (goal kicks/distribution).

id.name: id
id.description: Surrogate primary key of this table; unique row identifier with no external meaning. The listed joins to Match/Team_Attributes are spurious (accepted only by a statistics heuristic, not semantically valid).

long_passing.name: long_passing
long_passing.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): long passing skill.

long_shots.name: long_shots
long_shots.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): long shot skill.

marking.name: marking
marking.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): marking ability (man-marking in defense).

overall_rating.name: overall_rating
overall_rating.description: Overall player rating (33-94, FIFA-style 1-99 scale): the aggregate rating of the player at the given date.

penalties.name: penalties
penalties.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): penalty taking skill.

player_api_id.name: player_api_id
player_api_id.description: Foreign key to Player.player_api_id; identifies the player this rating row belongs to. Each player appears in many rows (one per rating date).

player_fifa_api_id.name: player_fifa_api_id
player_fifa_api_id.description: Foreign key to Player.player_fifa_api_id; the player's FIFA/EA identifier, alternative join key to the Player table.

potential.name: potential
potential.description: FIFA-style potential rating (39-97): the projected maximum overall rating the player can reach.

short_passing.name: short_passing
short_passing.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): short passing skill.

sliding_tackle.name: sliding_tackle
sliding_tackle.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): sliding tackle skill. The listed joins to Match.id / Player.id / Team_Attributes.id are spurious (numeric coincidence accepted by a statistics heuristic, not real references).

sprint_speed.name: sprint_speed
sprint_speed.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): top sprint speed.

standing_tackle.name: standing_tackle
standing_tackle.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): standing tackle skill.

vision.name: vision
vision.description: FIFA-style attribute rating (1-99): vision (ability to spot passes/opportunities).

table.name: Team
table.purpose: Reference/dimension table of 299 football (soccer) clubs, each row one team, with internal id, external API and FIFA identifiers, and long/short names. Teams are referenced by Match (home/away team) and presumably Team_Attributes.

id.name: id
id.description: Synthetic surrogate primary key for the team row; internal identifier with no external meaning.

team_api_id.name: team_api_id
team_api_id.description: External team identifier from the football data API (e.g. the European Soccer Database's data provider); used by Match.home_team_api_id and Match.away_team_api_id to link matches to teams.

team_fifa_api_id.name: team_fifa_api_id
team_fifa_api_id.description: Team identifier from the FIFA (video game / EA Sports) dataset; ~3.7% null and a few duplicates, so it is an optional, imperfect cross-reference to FIFA team data.

team_long_name.name: team_long_name
team_long_name.description: Full official name of the football club (e.g. 'Siena', 'Hibernian', 'Villarreal CF').

team_short_name.name: team_short_name
team_short_name.description: Three-letter abbreviation of the club name (e.g. 'SIE', 'CES', 'HIB'), not unique across teams.

table.name: Team_Attributes
table.purpose: Periodic snapshots (6 dates between 2010 and 2015) of each football team's tactical/playing-style ratings, as sourced from the FIFA video game series: build-up play (speed, dribbling, passing, positioning), chance creation (crossing, passing, shooting, positioning) and defence (pressure, aggression, team width, defender line). Each row is one team at one snapshot date, keyed by team_api_id / team_fifa_api_id linking to the Team table. Numeric ratings (roughly 20-80) are paired with categorical class labels; buildUpPlayDribbling is null in about two-thirds of rows while its class is always present.

buildUpPlayDribbling.name: buildUpPlayDribbling
buildUpPlayDribbling.description: Numeric rating (roughly 20-80) of how much the team relies on dribbling during build-up play. Null for ~66% of rows (the class column is always populated, so the raw number was often not recorded).

buildUpPlayDribblingClass.name: buildUpPlayDribblingClass
buildUpPlayDribblingClass.description: Categorical banding of build-up dribbling: Little / Normal / Lots.

buildUpPlayPassing.name: buildUpPlayPassing
buildUpPlayPassing.description: Numeric rating (20-80) of passing tendency in build-up play; higher values correspond to the Short passing class.

buildUpPlayPassingClass.name: buildUpPlayPassingClass
buildUpPlayPassingClass.description: Categorical banding of build-up passing style: Short / Mixed / Long.

buildUpPlayPositioningClass.name: buildUpPlayPositioningClass
buildUpPlayPositioningClass.description: Build-up play positioning style: Organised or Free Form.

buildUpPlaySpeed.name: buildUpPlaySpeed
buildUpPlaySpeed.description: Numeric rating (20-80) of the speed of build-up play; higher values correspond to the Fast class.

buildUpPlaySpeedClass.name: buildUpPlaySpeedClass
buildUpPlaySpeedClass.description: Categorical banding of build-up speed: Slow / Balanced / Fast.

chanceCreationCrossing.name: chanceCreationCrossing
chanceCreationCrossing.description: Numeric rating (20-80) of how much the team uses crosses to create chances; higher values correspond to the Lots class.

chanceCreationCrossingClass.name: chanceCreationCrossingClass
chanceCreationCrossingClass.description: Categorical banding of crossing in chance creation: Little / Normal / Lots.

chanceCreationPassing.name: chanceCreationPassing
chanceCreationPassing.description: Numeric rating (21-80) of the risk level of passing in chance creation; higher values correspond to the Risky class.

chanceCreationPassingClass.name: chanceCreationPassingClass
chanceCreationPassingClass.description: Categorical banding of chance-creation passing: Safe / Normal / Risky.

chanceCreationPositioningClass.name: chanceCreationPositioningClass
chanceCreationPositioningClass.description: Chance-creation positioning style: Organised or Free Form.

chanceCreationShooting.name: chanceCreationShooting
chanceCreationShooting.description: Numeric rating (22-80) of how much the team shoots when creating chances; higher values correspond to the Lots class.

chanceCreationShootingClass.name: chanceCreationShootingClass
chanceCreationShootingClass.description: Categorical banding of shooting in chance creation: Little / Normal / Lots.

date.name: date
date.description: Date on which this set of team attributes was recorded. Only 6 distinct dates (roughly twice a year, Feb and Sep, 2010-2015), i.e. periodic snapshots of each team's tactical ratings.

defenceAggression.name: defenceAggression
defenceAggression.description: Numeric rating (24-72) of defensive aggression; higher values correspond to the Press class.

defenceAggressionClass.name: defenceAggressionClass
defenceAggressionClass.description: Categorical banding of defensive aggression: Contain / Press / Double (team aggression).

defenceDefenderLineClass.name: defenceDefenderLineClass
defenceDefenderLineClass.description: Defensive line behaviour: Cover or Offside Trap.

defencePressure.name: defencePressure
defencePressure.description: Numeric rating (23-72) of how high up the pitch the team applies defensive pressure; higher values correspond to the High class.

defencePressureClass.name: defencePressureClass
defencePressureClass.description: Categorical banding of defensive pressure: Deep / Medium / High.

defenceTeamWidth.name: defenceTeamWidth
defenceTeamWidth.description: Numeric rating (29-73) of the team's defensive width; higher values correspond to the Wide class. The listed joins to Match.id / Player.id / Player_Attributes.id are spurious statistical matches, not real relationships.

defenceTeamWidthClass.name: defenceTeamWidthClass
defenceTeamWidthClass.description: Categorical banding of defensive team width: Narrow / Normal / Wide.

id.name: id
id.description: Surrogate primary key of the team-attributes snapshot row.

team_api_id.name: team_api_id
team_api_id.description: Identifier of the team this attribute snapshot belongs to, matching Team.team_api_id in the Team table (288 distinct teams, ~6 snapshots each). The listed joins to Player/Match ids are spurious numeric coincidences.

team_fifa_api_id.name: team_fifa_api_id
team_fifa_api_id.description: FIFA (video-game / EA) identifier of the same team, matching Team.team_fifa_api_id. The listed join to Player_Attributes.id is spurious.
